recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-10042 unless a future work group decision asks to revise the clinical content of these examples.
issue_request: FHIR-10042 was a Published/Persuasive PA work group Patient change request raised for DSTU2. It asked for a clean infant/newborn Patient example to support an Apgar Observation reference, and the resolution said an infant/newborn example would be added and would also cover mother/newborn encounter examples.
initial_application: The issue was applied by 06762498810717ae6625f73df3bfaaaf46ee37bc, which added Patient newborn, Patient mother, and RelatedPerson newborn-mother examples, and by 740dd686d00c40bed42272d55bd02e05b98c2519, which added infant twin, fetal infant, and infant mother Patient examples.
additional_context: Patient and RelatedPerson are active current build resources in source/fhir.ini and assigned to the PA work group. The current source uses list-Patient-examples.xml and list-RelatedPerson-examples.xml to register these examples. Zulip and Confluence searches found no contrary community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current source already contains and registers the requested newborn/infant examples and the associated mother/newborn RelatedPerson linkage.
